newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Deaths of Swiss couple go undetected for 19 days.
newsitem.headline: Deaths of Swiss couple go undetected for 19 days.

text.p: An elderly Swiss couple lay dead in their home for 19 days without neighbours or family members noticing anything was amiss, police said on Monday.

Aarau cantonal police said the 85-year-old husband emptied the mailbox in their single-family home for the last time on September 10. An autopsy showed he died of heart failure while sitting in front of the television set.
The body of his disabled wife, 83, was found in a bathroom. She apparently died of hypothermia shortly after her husband.
Their absence went unnoticed by neighbours and the mailman until a son living in France notified police, who broke down the door and found the corpses.
